title: West Kelowna Full Day Lunch Wine Tour-Incl Tastings & Guide Grat
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in West Kelowna
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Westside Wine Trail in West Kelowna is a dreamy mix of historic wineries, boutique gems, and stunning vineyard views! The "Holy Sip Tour" lets you taste up to 24 wines from five wineries, with plenty of time for a scenic vineyard lunch (bring your wallet!). Just a short drive from downtown Kelowna, this trail offers everything from iconic estates to small-batch treasures, all set against picturesque rolling hills and Okanagan Lake. Sip, savor, and enjoy the perfect blend of rural charm and wine sophistication!
